measurement: v2: independent lean C++ process timer, native child wall time and RSS; Python launch/log overhead counted separately
compatibility_revision: RC4 excluded for import assertion; MD5 excluded for incorrect default output; sim rejected legacy declaration statements. LLU/trie selected before any neural training; no performance-based replacement.

limits: Small single-machine pilot, process-wall timing, fixed Clang O3 backend without LTO/PGO; independent source-output oracle. Do not tune splits, epochs or capacity on test outcomes.
